abort_conditions: Abort if the fixture manifest hash differs from the bound hash.
Abort if either arm does not receive every listed fixture with seed 0 under otherwise identical settings.
Abort before exceeding 10 GPU-minutes or 20 wall-minutes.

candidate.single_delta: For the candidate evaluation arm only, substitute the existing critic_medium profile for critic_current, changing only Qwen reasoning effort from xhigh to medium.

proposal.claim: On four balanced critic fixtures, using the existing critic_medium profile instead of critic_current reduces median decision latency by at least 20% without lowering manifest-label accuracy.

guardrails: Use identical fixture text, seed, backend, model, and response limits for both arms; vary only the named profile.
Score both arms against the same manifest labels, and count missing or unparseable decisions as incorrect.
Do not alter serving configuration or any production default during evaluation.
experiment.pass_rule: Pass only if candidate median_decision_latency_ms is at most 0.80 times baseline and candidate manifest-label accuracy is not below baseline; otherwise fail.

proposal.falsifier: The claim is falsified if the candidate latency ratio exceeds 0.80, candidate manifest-label accuracy is below baseline, or the paired measurements cannot be completed within the caps.
proposal.title: Evaluate medium-effort Qwen critic profile
